title: I really like these - and I’m a guy :)
text:
I know these are marketed for the ladies, originally I bought this subscription to get as gifts for my female friends. I forgot to cancel the subscription and got a second round.

I figured I might as well try them out. I really enjoyed them. They are relaxing, not messy, easy to use. I am planning on keeping the subscription as they are low cost and a nice way to pamper yourself a bit.
label: positive
